scope: Historical contrast summaries; no reruns or changes to testing families. Seed t intervals are unadjusted 95%; Holm adjusts p-values. Original operational results lists and infrastructure paths are excluded.

M1_dynamics.interpretation: M1 conditional four-switch motion/entry intervention; fitted cycle/shape remains

M2_schedule.interpretation: M2 production top-two schedule versus no lock, complete simulations, same M3/retry rule; 40 planned programs per dataset

SCF_adapted.interpretation: On=MitoSync, Off=SCF adapted with generic Cellpose-SAM and original simulated-position correction. Equal positive event/negative/source/update budgets. Generator compute and fitted segmenters not matched; original SCF pipeline not reproduced.

MAGIK_balanced.interpretation: Historical exposed Fluo01 sampling diagnostic. Original negative result retained. Source/gap balancing changes sampling; geometry-only MAGIK cannot establish rendered-appearance value. Three seeds are training repeats, not new videos.
